up: Find all compounds that have been tested against the target APEX1 (CHEMBL5619), which is a human DNA repair nuclease/redox regulator. Return the compound name (pref_name), the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), and the canonical SMILES for each compound. Do not apply any additional filters on activity type, units, or relations. Do not limit the number of results.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM target_dictionary td JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5619'
